items.why: Fear gauge climbing as stocks slide and the 10-year yield hits its highest level since 2002, per CNBC and WSJ live updates.
Falling with risk assets as surging bond yields and a broad stock pullback sap appetite; moving with the broader tape.
Tech leading the decline as rising yields pressure growth names; Yahoo Finance notes the Dow, S&P and Nasdaq fell after the tech rally as bond yields and oil rose.
Chip stocks sliding with tech as the 10-year yield spikes to a 24-year high and indexes pull back from records; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Futures point lower with the 30-year yield at a fresh 24-year high; Fed minutes are on tap this afternoon.
summary: Stocks are selling off across the board this morning as the 10-year Treasury yield climbs to its highest level since 2002, pressuring tech and growth names. Futures are down roughly 0.7 to 1.1 percent while the VIX jumps.
